bills.summary_ai: This Georgia bill expands student loan forgiveness eligibility to include biomedical technicians in veterinary education programs. It amends state veterinary education law to allow biomedical technicians to participate in loan purchase agreements and loan cancellation programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians; authorize licensed veterinary technicians to administer antirabies vaccinations to animals
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands the scope of practice for licensed veterinary technicians in Georgia by authorizing them to administer rabies vaccinations to animals under direct veterinary supervision. This represents a delegation of duties that were previously restricted to licensed veterinarians.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians and Veterinary Technicians; licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians to practice veterinary teleadvice; authorize
bills.summary_ai: This Georgia bill expands the scope of practice for licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians to include veterinary teleadvice, teletriage, and telemedicine services. It establishes regulatory oversight by the State Board of Veterinary Medicine for these remote service delivery models.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians; practice and provision of veterinary teletriage and veterinary telemedicine; revise provisions
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends Georgia law to revise provisions governing veterinary teletriage and telemedicine services, explicitly including veterinary technicians alongside veterinarians. The legislation directly impacts the scope of practice and service delivery models available to veterinary paraprofessionals in remote care settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses the scope of practice for veterinary technicians and veterinary technologists by specifying which services they must be licensed to perform under veterinarian supervision and which services are restricted to licensed veterinarians only. It also clarifies veterinarian responsibility for paraprofessional work and modifies the Board of Veterinary Medicine membership.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands the veterinary paraprofessional workforce by establishing registration requirements and protections for veterinary professional associates (VPA), a higher-level paraprofessional role. It also extends telehealth prescription capabilities and creates public registry and disciplinary mechanisms for VPA registrants.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates a new veterinary paraprofessional category called veterinary professional associates (VPAs) and establishes a state registration system for them. It defines their scope of practice, allows them to provide veterinary medicine services under certain conditions, and grants regulatory authority to suspend or rescind their registration.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill comprehensively regulates veterinary technicians by establishing licensure requirements, defining their scope of practice, setting continuing education standards, and clarifying delegation authority from supervising veterinarians. It also distinguishes between licensed and unlicensed veterinary technicians while protecting the use of professional titles and establishing disciplinary procedures.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
bills.regulatory_type: scope of practice, licensure, title protection, delegation, continuing education, discipline

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands veterinary services access by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and establishing telehealth provisions for urgent conditions. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure and telehealth, it impacts paraprofessionals by potentially altering supervision structures and creating new practice models that affect how veterinary technicians and assistants work with these temporarily permitted veterinarians.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill regulates how veterinary care providers, including paraprofessionals, can use medical credit cards with clients. It prohibits advertising/promoting medical credit cards, receiving incentives for doing so, and charging for services before they are provided or for ancillary products without separate consent.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning State Law Protections For Health Care Providers And Patients Related To The Provision Of A Legally Protected Health Care Activity.
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends state law protections for health care providers and patients related to legally protected health care activities. Depending on implementation, this could provide legal protections for veterinary paraprofessionals when performing scope-of-practice activities and may clarify their authority to deliver veterinary care without legal liability.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses the continuation and licensing of pet animal care facilities under state agricultural oversight, implementing recommendations from a sunset review. Pet animal facilities employ veterinary paraprofessionals who provide direct animal care and must comply with facility licensing standards that govern their work environment and operational requirements.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses access to veterinary care through multiple mechanisms including expedited licensing for veterinarians, clarification of prescription and compounded drug use, and drug donation programs. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensing and drug regulations, these changes directly impact the scope of practice and working conditions for veterinary paraprofessionals who support veterinarians and handle medications under supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts the practice of cat declawing in veterinary medicine by amending the California Business and Professions Code. The restrictions on this surgical procedure directly affect what veterinary paraprofessionals can assist with or perform under veterinary supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.
bills.last_action: Senate amendments concurred in. To Engrossing and Enrolling. (Ayes 77. Noes 0.).
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends multiple California codes to establish or modify background check requirements for various professions and industries. Veterinary paraprofessionals may be affected if background check provisions are added to the Business and Professions Code sections governing veterinary licensure and practice standards.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals who handle antibiotics in clinical practice. Veterinary technicians and technologists frequently administer, dispense, and monitor antimicrobial medications under veterinary supervision, making them key implementers of antimicrobial stewardship protocols.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California law to define and regulate the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants. It directly addresses what tasks and duties these paraprofessionals are authorized to perform in veterinary medicine.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Enrolled and presented to the Governor at 4 p.m.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine laws by modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code related to veterinary practice, including adding new sections and repealing others. The amendments directly affect the regulation, licensing, and scope of practice for veterinary professionals and paraprofessionals in California.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary medicine regulations regarding the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which is the legal foundation defining what services veterinarians can provide and, critically, what tasks can be delegated to paraprofessionals. Changes to VCPR requirements directly impact the scope of practice and delegation authority for all veterinary paraprofessional categories.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends the Veterinary Medical Board regulations across multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code, governing veterinary practice standards, board operations, and professional requirements. The extensive amendments and additions to sections covering licensure, scope of practice, and professional conduct directly impact how veterinary paraprofessionals are regulated and supervised in California.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act For The Department Of Education - Division Of Higher Education Appropriation For The 2026-2027 Fiscal Year.
bills.last_action: Notification that SB58 is now Act 138
bills.summary_ai: This bill appropriates funding for higher education institutions in the 2026-2027 fiscal year, which may support veterinary technology and veterinary nursing educational programs that train paraprofessionals. The allocation could affect the availability and capacity of educational pathways for veterinary paraprofessional workforce development.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses ownership and oversight requirements for veterinary practices, which directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals are supervised, employed, and regulated within their work settings. Ownership and oversight structures determine scope of practice authority, supervision requirements, and the operational environment for all veterinary workforce categories.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses animal abuse and neglect classification, which is directly relevant to veterinary paraprofessionals who frequently encounter cases of animal cruelty and neglect in clinical settings. Veterinary paraprofessionals play a critical role in identifying, documenting, and reporting suspected abuse or neglect to veterinarians and authorities, making understanding these legal classifications essential to their professional responsibilities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses alternative educational pathways and certification requirements for veterinary technicians, directly impacting how paraprofessionals can qualify and obtain credentials in the veterinary field.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary technician certification and creates an alternative education pathway for becoming a certified veterinary technician, likely allowing individuals to qualify through means other than traditional formal education programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which directly impacts veterinary service delivery and workforce demand for surgical procedures. Veterinary paraprofessionals, particularly veterinary technicians and surgical assistants, will be essential to performing and supporting these procedures at scale across the state.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses, which could enable veterinary paraprofessionals to work under provisional credentials while pursuing full licensure or during workforce shortages. Temporary permits are particularly relevant for entry-level positions and credential transition periods in the veterinary field.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Extnd Bds:midwive/nursing/vet Exam/parole
bills.last_action: EFFECTIVE DATE(S) OF LAW SEE CHAPTER
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends the termination date of the Board of Veterinary Examiners, which is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing veterinary professional licensing and examination. The extension maintains ongoing regulatory oversight of veterinary professionals, including paraprofessionals who fall under the board's jurisdiction.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary licensing permits for certain professions, which could directly impact veterinary paraprofessionals seeking to work while completing licensure requirements or during credential transitions. Temporary permits are a key workforce availability tool for veterinary technicians and other paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a disaster emergency plan for pets and service animals in Alaska, which directly involves veterinarians and veterinary technicians in emergency response operations. The legislation addresses workforce deployment and responsibilities during disaster situations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines and modifies veterinary practice laws, including the powers and duties of veterinarians and their liability. It directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals by potentially expanding or clarifying their role in emergency care delivery for working dogs and defining their scope of practice within emergency medical contexts.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates funding mechanisms through tuition grants and loan forgiveness programs for allied health professionals, including veterinary paraprofessionals, to expand the rural workforce. The Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund specifically target training and financial support for veterinary technicians and related paraprofessional roles in underserved areas.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine; veterinarian-client-patient relationship further specified; scope of practice inside and outside veterinarian-client-patient relationship further defined
bills.summary_ai: This bill clarifies the veterinarian-client-patient relationship and defines the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside this relationship, which directly impacts what tasks can be delegated to veterinary paraprofessionals. The legislation establishes boundaries for veterinary paraprofessional duties by specifying what requires direct veterinarian involvement versus what can be performed independently or under supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
